contexts.text: In his comeliness and glory.
The glory () = a state of truth.
The rod of beauty () = power from truth.
The Lord's Spiritual Kingdom in the Heavens, and the Spiritual Church on earth is called glory. Illustrated.
Garments of beauty () = truths from good.
Delights of magnificence as to ornaments of house, and as to ornaments of garments.
The habitation of glory () = the Heaven where are those of the Spiritual Kingdom. AC 9815:2.
Towards the glory () = against the Church.

For glory, and for beauty () = to present Divine truth such as is in the Spiritual Kingdom joined to the Celestial Kingdom in an internal and an external form... Beauty = Divine truth in an external form; for the splendour and beauty of Divine truth appearing in externals is meant by beauty, Hence it is that the Word in the internal sense is called glory; but in the internal sense relatively to the derivative splendour and beauty, beauty.
The like is signified by beauty (or glory decus) in the following passages. Illustrated.
The beauty of Israel () = the Spiritual Church, which is called beauty (or glory) from the splendour and beauty of truth.
The land of glory () = the Lord's Church where is Divine truth, or the Word.
A crown of ornament, and a diadem of beauty ()... A crown of ornament = the wisdom which is of good; a diadem of beauty = the intelligence which is of truth. AE 272:4.

A crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a diadem of a kingdom in the hand of thy God ()... A crown of beauty = the wisdom which is of good; and a diadem of a kingdom = the intelligence which is of truth. AE 272:5.
The crown of your beauty () = the wisdom which is of good from Divine truth; for beauty = the Divine truth of the Church. Reference. AE 272:6.
For glory, and for beauty () = the truth of the Spiritual Church. Explained.
A crown of beauty () = spiritual good, which is the good of truth; a crown = good; beauty, what is spiritual.
Infants in Heaven become men in stature and comeliness according to the increase of intelligence with them.

Glory and honour are before Him; strength and beauty are in His sanctuary () ... As the Divine which proceeds and makes the Heavens is Divine truth and Divine good, it is said, Glory and honour are before Him; and the Divine good and Divine truth in the Church are meant by strength and beauty in His sanctuary.
Gird Thy sword upon Thy thigh... in Thy glory and Thine honour ()... By glory is signified Divine truth; and by honour, Divine good.
For Thou art the glory of their strength ()... Glory is said in the Word of the Church, and of the doctrine of truth there.
The east, and the glory () = where good is in its clearness through truth.
I will glorify the house of My glory () = the Lord's Divine Human in which they will be... The house of glory = His Divine Human as to Divine truth.
Our beauty () = the Spiritual Church.

The shoot of Jehovah shall be for beauty and glory () = that truth shall be born anew in the Church... As all beauty is from the spiritual affection of truth and the consequent conjunction; and as otherwise there is no beauty, it is said, Take away our reproach.
The rod of strength () = Divine truth in the natural sense; the rod of beauty the same in the spiritual sense.
He gave his glory into the hand of the enemy () = natural truth from spiritual; this is signified by glory: and its destruction by evils, is signified by to be given into the hand of the enemy.
The beauty of his ornament () = the Church and its doctrine.
